physicalNotes: No radius or mass of Hydra Cluster is recorded: it is an extended cluster of galaxies, and its package frames it at 1093600 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), a presentation value.

sources.position: Sadibekova et al. (2024), MCXC-II, A&A 688 A187; CDS J/A+A/688/A187, byte columns defined by https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/ftp/J/A+A/688/A187/ReadMe (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/ftp/J/A+A/688/A187/mcxcii.dat.gz); catalogue reference mcxc-ii:MCXC J1036.6-2731
sources.distance: Tully et al. (2023), Cosmicflows-4, ApJ 944, 94; CDS J/ApJ/944/94, tables 2 (group membership, 1PGC) and 3 (group distance modulus, DMzp), as joined into the Nearby Universe's tracked table (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/cat/J/ApJ/944/94); catalogue reference cosmicflows-4:31478: 54275020.97963173 pc; Cosmicflows-4 group distance: the weighted average of its members' distance moduli on the calibrated scale (table 3, DMzp).
sources.properMotion: Zero: the cluster of galaxies is held at its catalogued position; no motion across the sky is applied.
sources.radialVelocity: c z for the catalogued redshift z = 0.0133: Redshift reference 2004AJ....128.1558S, transcribed from MCXC-II. (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2004AJ....128.1558S); catalogue reference 2004AJ....128.1558S
